english.title: The Binding
english.detail:
Take this to the summoning circle in Neeru's tent, <Name>. Summon forth a foul succubus, then show it your mastery. I believe in the strength of your magic. As always, though, be wary, for pride and overconfidence has overcome many a promising warlock.

When you have defeated it, return the pendant to me so that I might deliver the news to Zankaja.
english.progress:
When I look upon a succubus, my heart begins to soar... But at the same time, I can almost sense my soul's ebb, drifting away like the tides.

Be wary, my friend.
english.complete:
Success! Be sure I expected nothing less from my star pupil.

You have proven your worth, and gladly will I show you the method of summoning your subdued succubus. Go now, you have much to learn, and when next I see you, I will expect you to have found true mastery over your succubus.

Leave the sorrow of Dogran and Zankaja to those of us who are longer in years, but remember it, and hold it as protection against the wiles of the dark power you have learned to summon today.

english.title: What Is Love?
english.objective: Retrieve the Wooden Figurine and bring it to Gakin the Darkbinder in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind.
english.detail:
You will need a powerful reagent to tempt an incubus -- an object that represents great devotion and love.

With my scrying, I have located a small figurine that should be suitable for your ritual.

Thousands of years ago, the figurine belonged to a young couple. The original owners are no more, but their keepsake has survived to the present day.

Follow the road north into Ashenvale, then west and past Maestra's Post. You will see a house nestled amongst the trees. There you will find what you seek.

english.title: What Is Love?
english.objective: Retrieve the Wooden Figurine and bring it to Gakin the Darkbinder in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind.
english.complete:
<Gakin turns the wooden figurine over in his hand.>

I sense the emotional energy residing within this artifact, undiminished by the passing of time. The incubus will be drawn to it like a fly to honey.

Takar never disappoints.

english.title: The Binding
english.detail:
The time has come at last. Bring the hearts to the summoning circle below. Place them at its center and call forth the incubus.

The demon will not be pleased when it realizes that you have tempted it into a trap. Do not fall prey to its beguilement, <Name>. You must subdue it fully.

Only then can I teach you the spell to bind it to your will.

english.title: The Binding
english.objective: Using the Lovers' Hearts, summon and subdue an incubus, then return the Lovers' Hearts to Carendin Halgar in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
english.progress:
The incubus possesses martial prowess, but its illusory charms are its most potent weapon. Falter for even a moment, and the demon will seize upon the opportunity to enthrall you.

Do not let it, <name>.
english.complete:
Impressive. Very impressive. The sayaad specialize in preying upon mortals. Many a <class> has thought themselves strong enough to command one, only to find themselves being commanded instead.

This trial did not break you, <name>, and your efforts have earned your reward. I will teach you the spell to summon the incubus.
